files_generated.description: Pinned four-stage Vue and Go production Dockerfile
Build context exclusions for secrets, local data, and generated assets
Hardened NAS Compose service using the GHCR image
Multi-platform GHCR build and publish workflow
Deployment guide for Compose, Docker Run, and GHCR
Updated Web console, image, endpoint, and development instructions

key_decisions.rationale: Vite must populate internal/web/dist before Go compiles the embedded filesystem.
Builders run on BUILDPLATFORM while pure Go cross-compiles for TARGETOS/TARGETARCH, avoiding emulation for amd64/arm64.
Verified Node 22.22.2, Go 1.26.2, and Alpine 3.23.3 manifest lists provide reproducible amd64/arm64 inputs.
The NAS service lives under /vol1/1000 and OAuth must write credentials to the bind-mounted auths directory.
The image contains config.example.json while .dockerignore excludes the real config and all credentials.
Both test suites are fast and validate the exact sources before an image is published.
